one_line_pitch: Evidence-gated document execution for high-stakes business workflows

criteria.description: PROGRESS: Full live path shown, not slides — prompt to extraction to review to generation to PDF to signature
criteria.pass_condition: All 8 demo steps visible in execution timeline with timestamps
criteria.fail_condition: Any step missing or shown as slide/mockup
criteria.sponsor_quote: How much progress did you make?

criteria.description: CONCEPT: Real problem clear in first 20 seconds — businesses cannot let uncertain model output become signed commitments
criteria.pass_condition: Opening narration articulates the problem of AI-generated signed documents
criteria.fail_condition: No clear problem statement in first 20 seconds
criteria.sponsor_quote: Does it solve a real problem?
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:00-0:20 — 'Agents can read and draft documents. The dangerous part is letting uncertain model output become a signed commitment.'

criteria.description: FEASIBILITY: Startup thesis clear in final 20 seconds — provider-neutral trust control plane for AI document workflows
criteria.pass_condition: Closing narration states startup thesis with at least 2 verticals
criteria.fail_condition: No startup thesis or only procurement mentioned
criteria.sponsor_quote: Could this become a startup or company?
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:40-3:00 — 'The product can generalize to procurement, contracts, insurance, financial operations...'

criteria.description: Public repo with setup instructions, README, and working demo
criteria.pass_condition: All files exist, README has > 500 chars with setup instructions
criteria.fail_condition: Missing files or no setup instructions

criteria.description: All three sponsor tracks selected on Devpost
criteria.pass_condition: Submission includes all three sponsor tracks

criteria.description: Synthetic demo documents only — no real PII
criteria.pass_condition: All demo data is synthetic with clearly fake company names
criteria.fail_condition: Real PII or real company data in fixtures

criteria.description: No secrets in repo, video, or client code
criteria.pass_condition: No hardcoded secrets in source code or committed config
criteria.fail_condition: API keys or secrets in codebase

criteria.pass_condition: No false compliance claims in README, demo, or code
criteria.fail_condition: Claims regulatory certification that doesn't exist

criteria.description: Product invariant holds: No irreversible action depends on unresolved or provenance-less fact
criteria.pass_condition: All 3 forbidden transitions blocked AND SignatureGate has 6 conditions
criteria.fail_condition: Any forbidden transition allowed or gate has fewer than 6 checks
criteria.sponsor_quote: No irreversible action may depend on an unresolved or provenance-less fact
